card.name: Inside a dose number before mg
card.fires_on: The space, digit or decimal point just before or within a dose amount, right before 'mg' or 'mg/kg' in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Space before amount
modes.description: A blank gap after a dosing phrase, just before the number.

modes.label: Digit after space
modes.description: The first digit of a dose that is followed by more digits.
